notes: Coordinates are in original 2048 x 1365 pixels. They were inspected with original-pixel crops and 50-pixel grid overlays.
All L and R names denote screen-left and screen-right in the reference front view.
The Jingwei reference is a human-faced bird with crown, hair, ribbons and avian wings, tail and claws. Preserve the human profile; do not add a beak.
Root is the torso control. Wings each use three rigid panels at the reference brass shoulder, elbow and wrist pivots. Each leg uses hip, knee and ankle rigid articulation.
Parts deliberately overlap by a few pixels around pivots. layer_cm separates their leather layers; brass rivets should cover the pivot seams.
All diagrams, dimension lines, dashed control-rod illustrations, labels and the bottom exploded layout must be excluded from mesh extraction.
White ornamental cutouts in the leather panels remain true holes. Avoid converting bright skin and pale yellow feather highlights into cutouts.

The main concept has wing tips partly crossed by dashed rod marks and feather interiors occluded by the legs. Extraction should suppress thin annotation strokes and honour exclude_polygons_px on tail panels.

The source dimension claims both height 160 cm and wingspan 240 cm, but its illustrated main silhouette has a width to height ratio about 1.72 rather than 1.50. Apply uniform height scaling and report actual wingspan; do not silently distort the silhouette.
Flight and Reach are conservative in-plane assembly poses for inspection, not newly invented gameplay logic or proof of runtime integration.
The source reference depicts a leather shadow puppet. Preserve planar construction and 0.65 cm thickness rather than replacing it with unrelated full-volume anatomy.
Expand each polygon crop mask by 4 px before foreground intersection to preserve hand-drawn edge strokes; this is intended part overlap at assembly seams.
QA Run1: excluded the thin dashed left control-rod annotation below the outer wing at original pixels x126-152, y381-447. This is not puppet geometry.

provenance.method: Contour-modeled extruded leather pieces from existing project concept; real holes, rigid articulation, cleaned artwork UV atlas; no purchased mesh or new image generation.
provenance.texture_note: Stylized painted artwork, not a scanned physical albedo. Existing design-sheet markings are excluded.
